description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement Your Oath is the Binding Clause, and you are somewhere the contract-holder's corporation has reach.

Cost 1 Conviction

You call in a favor owed to the contract-holder. Choose one: you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to a Diplomacy check to Make a Request, an Intimidation check to Coerce, or a check to Gather Information, made before the end of the scene; or you halve the time Gather Information takes you for the rest of the day. The favor is spent on the corporation's ledger, not yours, and Command knows you used it.
